privileged_info_for_vlm: The paper 'RNA Interference: Gene Silencing by Double-Stranded RNA' (or similar title) should have its year corrected to 1998 (Fire & Mello). The CRISPR-Cas9 paper should be dated 2013. The paper 'Caspase Activation Mechanisms in Apoptotic Cell Death' should be corrected from 1988 to 1998. Placeholder abstracts (e.g., 'Abstract goes here') must be deleted or replaced with scientific content. Author names must follow the 'Last, First' Zotero convention.
